business_summary: Tokyo Lifestyle Co., Ltd. engages in the retail and wholesale of beauty, health, sundry, and other products in Japan, China, Hong Kong, the United States, Canada, Thailand, and the United Kingdom. The company sells its products under its flagship brand, Tokyo Lifestyle. It offers cosmetics, including foundation, powder, concealer, makeup remover, eyeliner, eye shadow, brow powder, brow pencil, mascara, lip gloss, lipstick, and nail polish; skincare products comprising facial cleansers, whitening products, sunblock, moisturizers, facial masks, eye masks, eye gels, and exfoliating products; cosmetic applicators, such as brushes, puffs, curlers, hair irons, and shavers; perfumes and colognes; facial wash, firming lotion, astringent, and moisturizer for men; and lip balm, lotion, shampoo, soap, and essential oils for babies and children. The company also provides OTC drugs for the treatment of common ailments, such as colds, headaches, stomach pain, cough, and eye strain; vitamins, minerals, fiber supplements, nutritional yeast, dietary products, and other nutritional supplements; and a variety of general-purpose medical supplies and devices. In addition, it offers bedding and bath, home décor, dining and tabletop items, storage containers, car supplies, cleaning agent, and laundry supplies, as well as spa supplies, clothing, formula milk, and diapers. Further, the company provides watches, perfumes, handbags, clothes, and jewelry; Nintendo switch and Xbox series products; smart AC adapters and batteries; and collectible cards and toys. Additionally, it offers food, including soft drinks, packaged snacks, tea and coffee, fruit juice, and mineral water; alcoholic beverages; and miscellaneous products, such as cigarettes and pet food. The company was formerly known as Yoshitsu Co., Ltd and changed its name to Tokyo Lifestyle Co., Ltd. in October 2024. Tokyo Lifestyle Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Tokyo Lifestyle Co., Ltd.는 일본, 중국, 홍콩, 미국, 캐나다, 태국 및 영국에서 미용, 건강, 잡화 및 기타 제품의 소매 및 도매에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 주력 브랜드인 Tokyo Lifestyle로 제품을 판매합니다. 파운데이션, 파우더, 컨실러, 메이크업 리무버, 아이라이너, 아이섀도, 브로우 파우더, 브로우 펜슬, 마스카라, 립글로스, 립스틱, 매니큐어 등의 화장품을 제공합니다. 페이셜 클렌저, 미백 제품, 자외선 차단제, 보습제, 페이셜 마스크, 아이 마스크, 아이 젤 및 각질 제거 제품을 포함하는 스킨케어 제품; 브러쉬, 퍼프, 컬러, 고데기, 면도기 등의 화장 도구; 향수 및 코롱; 남성용 세안제, 퍼밍 로션, 수렴제 및 보습제; 아기와 어린이를 위한 립밤, 로션, 샴푸, 비누, 에센셜 오일 등이 있습니다. 이 회사는 또한 감기, 두통, 복통, 기침 및 눈의 피로와 같은 일반적인 질병 치료를 위한 OTC 의약품을 제공합니다. 비타민, 미네랄, 섬유질 보충제, 영양 효모, 식이 제품 및 기타 영양 보충제; 다양한 범용 의료용품 및 기기 등이 있습니다. 그 외에도 침구와 욕실, 호도 제공됩니다.
